Pinned key-only login returned UID2000 and PID1 systemd with ordinary SSH stopped, vendor control socket masked, broker/rc absent and ordinary imported authorized_keys absent
Password-only authentication, root, unapproved key, non-LAN source and separate non-br0 ingress all rejected
Stopping ordinary ssh.service preserved /run/sshd, an existing recovery session and a new recovery login
Recovery socket restart and br0 removal/recreation each permitted subsequent key login
Native passwd/shadow/group/gshadow and ordinary sshd_config checksums unchanged
remaining_gate: Provision exact already enrolled h0 public key only; retain existing valid native account/shadow/PAM and stable existing ed25519 host key
Enable br0.device.wants during candidate provisioning; explicitly start once only when installing into an already active bridge
From authorized .51 client use existing netpanel private identity and separately pinned native host key to establish MastermixStudios@candidate:2222 after native boot
Repeat after a fresh native reboot and ordinary SSH/vendor control restart; assert PID1 systemd/actual slot and stable host/key identities without outputting secrets
Assert native public-key access survives unavailable vendor password import; confirm LAN firewall/interface limits on actual target
Preserve existing sudo authentication policy; public-key access alone does not promise privileged recovery when the native sudo password is lost
limitations: Public-key login still requires a valid native account and successful PAM account/session checks
Existing sudo can require the native password; no unrestricted passwordless root recovery is granted
Missing br0, LAN/firewall failure, filesystem damage or systemd failure remain outside this recovery path
